Receiving yards: confidence trimmed (0.88 → 0.75); leans won less often than their stated chance.
Defense vs his position counts more now (0.49 → 0.58): when it pushed a projection up, the player beat his baseline 51% of the time (161 props); when it pushed down, he fell short 54% (205).
Receptions: confidence trimmed (0.74 → 0.63); leans won less often than their stated chance.
